data.summary: Microscopist on 4 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 9 observations; candidates: Aurora kinase inhibitors

observations.finding: Treated fields are sparse with large black background vs DMSO near-confluent monolayer with identical contrast settings.

Cell size per remaining object larger and rounded/spiky with prominent red cortical rim vs DMSO flat polygonal cells; corresponds to w_13173fc040 cell_count z=-12.33 value 85.25 vs DMSO median 311.5 and w_17353b8062 cells_measured 178 vs ~311.

Blue DNA: DMSO = single oval uniform nuclei; Treated = highly irregular, lobed and fragmented nuclei, many cells contain grape-like clusters of small blue puncta/micronuclei and few very large nuclei at both 0.03 and 0.3 uM.

Irregular nuclei quantified: nuc_solidity z -69.88 value 0.944 vs 0.972 and z -48.34 value 0.952 vs 0.972; nuc_form_factor z -49.93/-49.89 value 0.828 vs 0.917; frac_multinucleate_proxy z +14.22/+14.78 value 0.573/0.585 vs 0.268; frac_large_nucleus z +12.14/+22.76 value 0.061/0.104 vs 0.013.
Total blue DNA intensity per cell increased and heterogeneous; nuclei stain brighter/coarser vs DMSO.
Increased DNA content measured as nuc_dna_integrated z +11.53 value 579.8 vs 291.9 in w_13173fc040 consistent with large/polyploid nuclei.

Red F-actin: markedly brighter and more heterogeneous cortical red signal per cell in treated vs dim diffuse red in DMSO; act_mean z +12.04 value 0.472 vs 0.293; act_std z +23.79/+14.79 value 0.18/0.139 vs 0.072; act_glcm_contrast z +13.12 value 0.003 vs 0.001.

Green beta-tubulin filamentous network less distinct in treated (diffuse perinuclear green) vs DMSO radial microtubule filaments; red predominates, act_tub_ratio z +13.56/+12.13 value 1.64/1.576 vs 1.033.

Increase in bright white-yellow rounded cells (red+green overlap, condensed DNA) scattered in all treated fields vs rare in DMSO, suggesting arrested mitotic/condensed cells. No corresponding measurement provided.

notable_cells.why: central cluster of multinucleate cells with grape-like blue micronuclei, diffuse green tubulin and intense red cortical actin
large cell with dense cluster of ~20 small blue nuclei, exemplifying frac_multinucleate_proxy increase
group of cells with irregular lobed large nuclei and punctate micronuclei illustrating solidity/form_factor drop
large polyploid cell with ~30 punctate blue nuclei corresponding to frac_large_nucleus and DNA increase

candidate_mechanisms.why: phenotype dominated by failed cytokinesis: dramatic nuc_solidity/form_factor decrease, very high frac_multinucleate_proxy and frac_large_nucleus with increased nuc_dna_integrated, low cell_count, and persistent mitotic rounded cells is classic Aurora B inhibition polyploidy/multinucleation, distinct from simple microtubule or actin disruption; both concentrations show same pattern dose-dependent.

report.uncertainty: Only composites provided; green/red overlap inferred from colour. Actin increase could also accompany other cytokinesis failure MoAs but combination of extreme nuclear irregularity + multinucleation + polyploidy best matches Aurora kinase inhibitors among given list.

reflection.text:
Unblinded as demecolcine/colcemid, truth Microtubule destabilizers - verdict correct. I was right to weight the quantitative atlas and replicated morphology over the single microscopist call.

What got it right:
- 4 wells acquired across 0.03 uM to 10 uM (w_17353b8062 dose 2, w_13173fc040 dose 4, w_c4bb8c8ab5 dose 6, w_fe26c7e5aa dose 7) all showed extreme nuclear dysmorphia: nuc_solidity z -69.9 to -33.0 and nuc_form_factor z -49.9 to -31.7, with frac_large_nucleus z +19.4 to +22.8 and act_std z +21.3 to +23.8. That pattern of lobed/irregular nuclei + large/polyploid nuclei + cell count loss (dose_response cell_count Spearman rho=-1.00, p=0) replicated at every dose, consistent with mitotic failure from microtubule destabilization.
- compare_to_reference_atlas was decisive: NSC 2/2, then 3/3, then 4/4 for Microtubule destabilizers, with k-neighbors 9/10 Microtubule destabilizers 1/10 Eg5 inhibitors at each step. Per-well similarities ~0.87-0.92 in the review. Even with a microscopist candidate of Aurora kinase inhibitors on 4 fields (e6), I kept that hypothesis at 0.07 in update_hypotheses and did not chase it because the leave-one-compound-out atlas vote was unanimous.
- lookup_compound and literature search confirmed identity: demecolcine PubChem CID 220401 = colcemid, name and BBBC021 structure agree, chembl_mechanisms empty but PubMed hits for 'demecolcine colcemid microtubule destabilizer mechanism' returned 3/3. The literature in this run defines colcemid by tubulin resistance mutations, supporting colcemid as a microtubule destabilizer reference: PMID 12883031, PMID 17938271, PMID 22669706.

What misled / what I missed:
- e12 dose_response tub_mean over 4 doses rho=+0.60 p=0.4 was flat, contradicting a simple expectation of tubulin intensity loss for a destabilizer. I listed it as contradicting in the hypothesis history but correctly did not flip the call; quantitative tub_mean in this Cell Painting-like assay is not a direct polymerization readout and was outweighed by nuclear shape and atlas similarity.
- e6 describe_phenotype Aurora suggestion was plausible because frac_large_nucleus and multinucleation/polyploidy also occur with Aurora inhibition. I treated this correctly as non-specific, but I did not acquire an additional phospho-histone H3 or mitotic index stain that would have discriminated more directly; with budget at 4 of 4 wells left initially and exhausted after 4 acquisitions, no affordable follow-up was available per review.
- e8 frac_multinucleate_proxy rho=-0.50 p=0.67 and e13 nuc_solidity rho=+0.40 p=0.6, e14 frac_large_nucleus rho=+0.40 p=0.6 showed no clear dose trend, which I noted but did not over-interpret - the absolute z-scores were already saturated at the lowest dose (0.03 uM z -69.9 for solidity), indicating potent effect reached early, not lack of effect.
- Eg5 inhibitors persisted as 1/10 neighbors; acquisition choice to sample mid (0.3 uM), high-mid (3 uM), low (0.03 uM) and high (10 uM) was good for coverage, but did not resolve that minor neighbor class. Given unanimity of NSC, that residual was appropriately left in the 0.88 vs 1.0 probability.
